name: generated-visual-case-evidence

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Generated page, component and layout screenshot cases must retain their real pixels with the declared case, state, viewport, revision and served build; missing baselines continue to fail.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
